security_audit.summary: All 27 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown syntax, relative documentation links, or ordinary retention terminology. Two semantic risks remain: obstructive cancellation guidance and insufficient authentication guidance for payment-update links.

remediation.issue: The high-value account flow can block self-service cancellation and require a customer-success call.
remediation.suggestion: Keep cancellation available in the original channel and make customer-success contact optional. Align every flow with applicable cancellation laws.

remediation.issue: Payment-update links are recommended without login, but the skill does not specify secure authorization controls.
remediation.suggestion: Require signed, single-use, short-lived billing portal sessions. Bind each session to the intended customer and avoid exposing payment details.

content.user_title: Reduce SaaS Churn with Better Retention Flows
content.value_statement: Subscriber churn reduces recurring revenue and hides product problems. This skill designs ethical cancellation flows, targeted save offers, and payment recovery programs.
actual_capabilities: Designs exit surveys and maps cancellation reasons to relevant save offers.
Creates cancellation flows with pauses, downgrades, discounts, confirmations, and post-cancel steps.
Develops payment retry schedules, dunning email sequences, and grace-period policies.
Builds churn health scores from usage, support, billing, and engagement signals.
Defines retention metrics, cohorts, benchmarks, and controlled experiment plans.
limitations: Does not connect to billing, analytics, or messaging platforms.
Requires product, pricing, usage, and cancellation data for tailored recommendations.
Benchmark figures are general guidance and should be validated against current business data.
Legal and payment-security requirements need review by qualified specialists.

use_cases.title: Design a Fair Cancellation Flow
use_cases.description: Create an exit survey, reason-based offers, clear cancellation controls, and confirmation messaging for a subscription product.

use_cases.title: Recover Failed Payments
use_cases.description: Plan payment retries, dunning messages, grace periods, and reactivation steps for recurring billing.

use_cases.title: Build Retention Campaigns
use_cases.description: Translate churn signals and cancellation reasons into targeted outreach, tests, and measurement plans.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Cancellation Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an ethical cancellation flow for [product], serving [customer type] at [price]. Include one survey, relevant offers, clear cancellation, and confirmation copy.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a first cancellation experience for a subscription product.

prompt_templates.title: Map Reasons to Save Offers
prompt_templates.prompt: Map these cancellation reasons to suitable offers: [reasons]. For each reason, provide one primary offer, one fallback, eligibility rules, and success metrics.
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve offer relevance without using a blanket discount.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Failed Payment Recovery
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a dunning plan for [billing provider], [billing interval], and [customer type]. Include retry timing, four messages, a grace period, and reactivation steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Reduce involuntary churn from failed recurring payments.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Retention Experiment System
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [cohort data], [usage signals], [cancel reasons], and [payment failures] to create a health score and intervention matrix. Define thresholds, experiments, guardrails, and metrics.
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinate proactive retention across product, marketing, support, and billing teams.

output_examples.input: Create a cancellation flow for a monthly project tool costing $49.
output: Ask one optional exit question with six clear reasons.
Offer a pause for temporary needs, a lower plan for price concerns, or support for technical issues.
Keep the cancellation action visible and confirm the access end date.

output_examples.input: Plan dunning for failed annual subscription payments.
output: Send a renewal notice before billing and use provider-supported smart retries.
Use four direct reminders that explain timing, account status, and secure payment-update steps.
Apply a documented grace period before pausing access, then provide a simple reactivation path.

output_examples.input: Create a churn health score for a team SaaS product.
output: Weight login frequency, core feature use, support sentiment, billing health, and team activity.
Define healthy, attention, at-risk, and critical bands from historical retention data.
Assign measured interventions to each band and review false positives regularly.

best_practices: Keep the cancellation path clear, accessible, and as easy as signup.
Match each intervention to verified customer behavior or a stated cancellation reason.
Measure retained lifetime value, not only immediate offer acceptance.
anti_patterns: Do not hide cancellation controls or require unwanted sales contact.
Do not apply the same discount to every customer or cancellation reason.
Do not use sensitive behavioral data without a lawful purpose, consent, and access controls.

faq.question: What types of churn does this skill address?
faq.answer: It addresses voluntary cancellations and involuntary churn caused by failed recurring payments.

faq.question: Does the skill implement billing changes?
faq.answer: No. It provides plans, copy, rules, and measurement guidance for teams to implement.

faq.question: Which billing providers are covered?
faq.answer: The guidance discusses Stripe, Chargebee, Paddle, Recurly, and Braintree at a planning level.

faq.question: Can it optimize an existing cancellation flow?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide flow steps, cancellation reasons, offer results, cohorts, and retained lifetime value.

faq.question: Does it provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. Review cancellation, renewal, privacy, and payment requirements with qualified specialists.

faq.question: What data improves the recommendations?
faq.answer: Use churn rates, customer segments, plan details, usage signals, cancellation reasons, payment failures, and historical offer results.
